name: Jason's House Meditation

Meditations count toward the 15 of 18 on the 100% checklist, and the Positive Mental Attitude trophy asks for every spot (PowerPyx).

name: Kenton's treasure sets
summary: Seven sets of shipwreck treasure dives given by Kenton Rees in Key Lento. The 100% checklist asks for 5 of the 7.
body: PowerPyx says Kenton's optional work opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, that he is away for a time after Chapter 1 and returns during Chapters 2 to 3, and that it stays open after the story.
He marks treasure places on the map, the treasure is dug from the sea floor with the metal detector, and it is brought back to his shop (PowerPyx).
PowerPyx says finishing his last mission earns the This Was No Boat Accident trophy.
DayOne's contacts list shows the stats kept for Kenton: shipwrecks cleared, meteorites sold, doubloons sold and cash earned.
Neither guide names the seven sets or their wrecks.

facts.reward: This Was No Boat Accident trophy for his final mission

name: Underwater treasures

DayOne's equipment guide says the metal detector works underwater and is used for Kenton's treasure hunting.

body: DayOne lists it among the Exploration challenges and gives no places for the wrecks.

name: Underwater Discoveries challenge
summary: DayOne lists a challenge for exploring any 25 unusual sights on the ocean floor. The 100% checklist asks for all 33.
body: PowerPyx describes the 33 Underwater Discoveries as sunken shipwrecks that belong to Kenton's work; DayOne's challenge text calls them unusual sights on the ocean floor.
No guide read had named or placed any of the 33 by November 18, 2026.

name: Bret's target decks
summary: Fifteen hunting tasks given by Bret Vogel to Jason. The 100% checklist asks for all 15.
body: PowerPyx says Bret's work opens some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, with a text to Jason that marks the mission Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, and that only Jason can do it.
After that mission Bret marks hunting places on the map and asks for particular animals, which Jason brings to him (PowerPyx).
PowerPyx says Bret hands over a hunting rifle it calls the Killtelligence SM-69; DayOne's hunting guide calls the rifle the Shrewsbury SM-69 and describes Bret as the owner of Killtelligence.
The Fair Game trophy is for hunting a unique animal for Bret, and PowerPyx had not confirmed which animal.
Neither guide names the 15 decks or the animals in them.

facts.reward: Fair Game trophy for hunting a unique animal for Bret
